name: Modern Studio Steps to Hayward Field + Deck
summary:
Immerse yourself in the energy of Eugene from this modern studio located blocks from Hayward Field and the University of Oregon. Designed for the efficient traveler, this space marries minimalism with luxury, featuring cozy heated floors, soaring skylights, and a private deck perfect for morning coffee.

*shares wall with main house. Parking, yard, entrance all your own

Whether you're here for a track meet or a campus tour, this is your serene, light-filled sanctuary in the Historic District.

sections.title: The space
sections.text:
The Space: Light & Air: Vaulted ceilings and generous skylights flood the space with natural light.

Luxury Underfoot: Radiant floor heating ensures you stay cozy even on PNW mornings.

Private Outdoors: Step out onto your exclusive private deck—a rare find for a studio.

Efficient Living: While there is no full cooktop, the well-appointed kitchenette features a mini-fridge, Keurig coffee maker, kettle, and essentials to fuel your day.

Sleep: A plush Full bed with premium linens guarantees a restorative night's rest.

sections.title: Guest access
sections.text: Access to fenced yard and private deck. Your own parking spot for one car. Studio entrance is private not attached to main home.

sections.title: Other things to note
sections.text:
